caption: Cheerful Brazilian children's pop song, extremely catchy singalong earworm, warm friendly adult male lead vocal with a kids choir answering the hook, bright and playful, clean polished mix, the hook starts right on the first beat with no intro, every section lasts exactly 4 bars, short repeated chorus, simple melody in small steps, call and response with the kids choir, the last chorus goes up by a whole step (key change), clear Portuguese pronunciation of every word, funny bouncy bass, playful ukulele, hand claps, quirky xylophone, comedic call and response, kids choir shouting the hook
lyrics:

Já é hora de dormir? Ah, não, não, não!
Só mais cinco minutinhos, só mais um, só mais um!
Tá bom, tá bom, tá bom, eu vou!
